works.title: Carmen
works.summary: Carmen is an opera in four acts by the French composer Georges Bizet. The libretto was written by Henri Meilhac and Ludovic Halévy, based on the novella of the same title by Prosper Mérimée.

works.title: The Magic Flute
works.summary: The Magic Flute, K. 620, is an opera in two acts by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart to a German libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder.

works.title: La traviata
works.summary: La traviata is an opera in three acts by Giuseppe Verdi set to an Italian libretto by Francesco Maria Piave. It is based on La Dame aux camélias (1852), a play by Alexandre Dumas fils, which he adapted from his own 1848 novel.

works.title: Madama Butterfly
works.summary: Madama Butterfly is an opera in three acts (originally two) by Giacomo Puccini, with an Italian libretto by Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa.

works.title: Aida

works.title: The Marriage of Figaro

works.title: Tosca
works.summary: Tosca is an opera in three acts by Giacomo Puccini to an Italian libretto by Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa.

works.title: Rigoletto
works.summary: Rigoletto is an opera in three acts by Giuseppe Verdi. The Italian libretto was written by Francesco Maria Piave based on the 1832 play Le roi s'amuse by Victor Hugo.

works.title: Der Ring des Nibelungen
works.summary: Der Ring des Nibelungen (The Ring of the Nibelung), WWV 86, is a cycle of four German-language epic music dramas composed by Richard Wagner.

works.title: Nabucco
works.summary: Nabucco is an Italian-language opera in four acts composed in 1841 by Giuseppe Verdi to an Italian libretto by Temistocle Solera.

works.title: Turandot
works.summary: Turandot is an opera in three acts by Giacomo Puccini to a libretto in Italian by Giuseppe Adami and Renato Simoni.

works.title: Tristan und Isolde
works.summary: Tristan und Isolde (Tristan and Isolde), WWV 90, is a music drama in three acts by Richard Wagner set to a German libretto by the composer, loosely based on Gottfried von Strassburg's medieval 12th-century romance Tristan and Iseult.

works.title: The Barber of Seville
works.summary: The Barber of Seville, or The Useless Precaution is an opera buffa (comic opera) in two acts composed by Gioachino Rossini with an Italian libretto by Cesare Sterbini.

works.title: Il trovatore

works.title: Cavalleria rusticana

works.title: Così fan tutte

works.title: I Medici
works.summary: I Medici is an opera in four acts composed by Ruggero Leoncavallo, with a libretto by the composer. Set in Renaissance Florence at the court of Lorenzo de' Medici, it was intended as the first part of a planned but unfinished trilogy called Crepusculum.

works.title: Il campanello

works.title: Il crociato in Egitto

works.title: Jonny spielt auf

works.title: L'ajo nell'imbarazzo

works.title: L'Arlesiana

works.title: L'assedio di Calais

works.title: L'étoile

works.title: La verità in cimento
works.summary: La verità in cimento is an opera by Antonio Vivaldi to a libretto by Giovanni Palazzi and Domenico Lalli. The opera, Vivaldi's 13th, was premiered on 26 October 1720 at the Teatro San Angelo in Venice.

works.title: Le astuzie femminili
works.summary: Le astuzie femminili (Feminine wiles) is a dramma giocoso in four acts by Domenico Cimarosa with an Italian libretto by Giuseppe Palomba.

works.title: Le chalet

works.title: Le nozze in villa
works.summary: Le nozze in villa (The Wedding in the Villa) is an opera buffa in two acts by Gaetano Donizetti, dating to early in his career.

works.title: Les mamelles de Tirésias
works.summary: Les mamelles de Tirésias (The Breasts of Tiresias) is an opéra bouffe by Francis Poulenc, in a prologue and two acts based on the eponymous play by Guillaume Apollinaire.
works.tagline: Surrealist opéra bouffe by Francis Poulenc

works.title: Lodoïska
based_on: Jean-Baptiste Louvet de Couvrai's Les amours du chevalier de Faublas

works.title: May Night

works.summary: May Night is a comic opera in three acts, four scenes, by Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov from a libretto by the composer which is based on Nikolai Gogol's story "May Night, or the Drowned Maiden", from his collection Evenings on a Farm Near Dikanka (1829-1832).

works.title: Mireille
works.summary: Mireille is an 1864 opera in five acts by Charles Gounod to a French libretto by Michel Carré after Frédéric Mistral's poem Mirèio.

works.title: Moulin Rouge!

works.title: Nanta

works.title: Nikola Šubić Zrinjski
works.summary: Nikola Šubić Zrinjski is an opera written and composed by Ivan Zajc in 1876. It is a retelling of the Battle of Szigetvár of 1566, in which Nikola IV Zrinski, Ban of Croatia and captain of the assembled Croatian and Hungarian forces, took a heroic last stand…

works.title: Paganini

works.tagline: 1925 operetta in three acts by Franz Lehár

works.title: Parisina
works.summary: Parisina (also known as Parisina d'Este) is an opera (tragedia lirica), in three acts by Gaetano Donizetti. Felice Romani wrote the Italian libretto after Byron's 1816 poem Parisina.

works.title: Pénélope

works.title: Phaëton

works.title: Saint François d'Assise
works.summary: Saint François d'Assise : Scènes Franciscaines, or simply Saint François d'Assise, is an opera in three acts and eight scenes by French composer Olivier Messiaen, who was also its librettist; written from 1975 to 1979, with orchestration and copying from 1979…

works.title: Taras Bulba

works.title: Owen Wingrave

works.summary: Owen Wingrave, Op. 85, is an opera in two acts with music by Benjamin Britten and libretto by Myfanwy Piper, after a short story by Henry James.

works.title: Paride ed Elena
works.summary: Paride ed Elena is an opera by Christoph Willibald Gluck. It is the third of Gluck's so-called reform operas for Vienna, following Orfeo ed Euridice and Alceste, and the least often performed of the three.

works.title: Persée
works.summary: Persée (Perseus) is a tragédie lyrique with music by Jean-Baptiste Lully and a libretto by Philippe Quinault, first performed on 18 April 1682 by the Opéra at the Théâtre du Palais-Royal in Paris.

works.title: Pinotta
works.summary: Pinotta is an idillio or opera in 2 acts by Pietro Mascagni from an Italian libretto by Giovanni Targioni-Tozzetti.

works.title: Poro
works.summary: Poro, re dell'Indie ("Porus, King of the Indians", HWV 28) is an opera seria in three acts by George Frideric Handel.

works.title: Powder Her Face
based_on: life of Margaret Campbell, Duchess of Argyll
works.summary: Powder Her Face, Op. 14 (1995), is a chamber opera in two acts by the British composer Thomas Adès, with an English libretto by Philip Hensher.

works.title: Renard
works.summary: Renard: histoire burlesque chantée et jouée, or The Fox: burlesque tale sung and played, is a chamber opera-ballet for four male voices and sixteen instrumentalists written in 1916 by Igor Stravinsky.

works.title: Rita
works.summary: Deux Hommes et une femme (Two Men and a Woman), also known as Rita, is an opéra comique in one act, composed by Gaetano Donizetti to a French libretto by Gustave Vaëz.

works.title: Rosmonda d'Inghilterra
works.summary: Rosmonda d'Inghilterra (Rosamund of England) is a melodramma or opera in two acts by Gaetano Donizetti. The Italian libretto was written by Felice Romani originally for Coccia's Rosmunda (1829).

works.title: Sancia di Castiglia

works.title: Scipione

works.title: Siberia

works.title: Silla
works.summary: Silla (full title Lucio Cornelio Silla, HWV 10) is an opera seria (referred to as a dramma per musica) in three acts by George Frideric Handel.

works.title: Sister Act

works.tagline: 2006 musical by Alan Menken and Glenn Slater

works.title: Sosarme

works.title: Tarare

works.summary: Tarare is an opéra (tragédie lyrique) composed by Antonio Salieri to a French libretto by Pierre Beaumarchais.

works.title: Teseo

works.title: The Brandenburgers in Bohemia

works.title: The Consul

works.title: The Indian Queen

works.title: The Jacobin
works.summary: Jakobín, or The Jacobin, is an operatic pastoral comedy in three acts by Antonín Dvořák, his Op. 84 (B. 159). Its Czech libretto by Marie Červinková-Riegrová employs characters from Alois Jirásek's story At the Ducal Court but in a plot of her devising.
works.tagline: Operatic pastoral comedy by Antonín Dvořák

works.title: The Kiss
works.summary: The Kiss is an opera in two acts, with music by Bedřich Smetana and text by Eliška Krásnohorská, based on a novel by Karolina Světlá.

works.title: The Secret

works.title: The Story of a Real Man

works.title: Tolomeo

works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.title: Actéon

works.title: Amleto
works.summary: Amleto is an Italian opera in four acts by Franco Faccio set to a libretto by Arrigo Boito, based on Shakespeare's play Hamlet.

works.summary: Pimpinone, TWV 21:15, is a comic opera by the German composer Georg Philipp Telemann with a libretto by Johann Philipp Praetorius.

works.title: Polish Blood
works.summary: Polenblut is a German-language operetta in three scenes by Czech composer Oskar Nedbal with a libretto by Austrian playwright Leo Stein.

works.title: Pomme d'api
works.summary: Pomme d'api is a one-act opérette of 1873 by Jacques Offenbach with a French libretto by Ludovic Halévy and William Busnach.
works.tagline: One-act opérette of 1873 by Jacques Offenbach

works.title: Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
based_on: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
works.summary: Priscilla, Queen of the Desert is a jukebox musical with book by Australian film director-writer Stephan Elliott and Allan Scott, using well-known pop songs as its score.
works.tagline: 2006 musical by Stephan Elliott and Allan Scott

works.title: Prisoner of the Caucasus
works.summary: The Prisoner of the Caucasus is an opera in three acts, composed by César Cui. The libretto is credited to Viktor Krylov, and is based on Alexander Pushkin's 1822 poem The Prisoner of the Caucasus.

works.title: Psyché
works.summary: Psyché is an opera (tragédie lyrique) in a prologue and five acts composed by Jean-Baptiste Lully to a libretto by Thomas Corneille (adapted from Molière's original play for which Lully had composed the intermèdes).

works.title: Riccardo Primo
works.summary: Riccardo primo, re d'Inghilterra ("Richard the First, King of England", HWV 23) is an opera seria in three acts written by George Frideric Handel for the Royal Academy of Music (1719).

works.title: Riders to the Sea
works.summary: Riders to the Sea is a short one-act opera by Ralph Vaughan Williams, based on the play of the same name by John Millington Synge.

works.title: Ritter Pázmán
works.summary: Ritter Pázmán (Knight Pazman) is a three-act comic opera composed by Johann Strauss II, with the libretto by Ludwig Dóczi.

works.title: Robert Bruce
works.summary: Robert Bruce is an 1846 pastiche opera in three acts, with music by Gioachino Rossini and Louis Niedermeyer to a French-language libretto by Alphonse Royer and Gustave Vaëz.

works.title: Roland
works.summary: Roland is an opera with music by Jean-Baptiste Lully and a libretto by Philippe Quinault. It was first performed on January 8, 1685, at the Palace of Versailles by the Académie Royale de Musique (Paris Opera) and later, beginning on March 8, 1685, at the…

works.title: Ruddigore
works.summary: Ruddigore; or, The Witch's Curse, originally called Ruddygore, is a comic opera in two acts, with music by Arthur Sullivan and libretto by W.

works.title: Rudolf
based_on: A Nervous Splendor: Vienna 1888-1889 by Frederic Morton, Conceived for the stage by Frank Wldhorn and Steve Cuden
works.summary: Rudolf is a musical conceived for the stage by Frank Wildhorn and Steve Cuden, with a book by Jack Murphy and Phoebe Hwang, lyrics by Murphy, additional lyrics by Nan Knighton, and music by Frank Wildhorn.

works.title: Salammbô
works.summary: Salammbô [alternative title: The Libyan] is an unfinished opera in four acts by Modest Mussorgsky. The fragmentary Russian language libretto was written by the composer, and is based on the novel Salammbô (1862) by Gustave Flaubert, but includes verses taken…

works.title: Sapho
works.summary: Sapho is a pièce lyrique ("lyric play", an opera in a declamatory style) in five acts. The music was composed by Jules Massenet to a French libretto by Henri Cain and Arthur Bernède, based on the novel (1884) of the same name by Alphonse Daudet.

works.title: Satyagraha
works.summary: Satyagraha is a 1980 opera in three acts for orchestra, chorus and soloists, composed by Philip Glass, with a libretto by Glass and Constance DeJong.

works.title: Singin' in the Rain
works.summary: Singin' in the Rain is a stage musical with story by Betty Comden and Adolph Green, lyrics by Arthur Freed, and music by Nacio Herb Brown.
works.tagline: 1983 stage musical adapted from the 1952 film of the same name

works.title: Tarzan
works.summary: Tarzan is a musical based on the Walt Disney Animation Studios 1999 film of the same name, with music and lyrics by Phil Collins, and a book by David Henry Hwang.

works.title: The Gamblers
works.summary: The Gamblers, Op. 63, is an unfinished opera, composed by Dmitri Shostakovich in 1941/42 to his own libretto based on Nikolai Gogol's comedy The Gamblers (1842).

works.title: The Old Maid and the Thief
works.summary: The Old Maid and the Thief is a radio opera in one act by Italian-American composer Gian Carlo Menotti. The work uses an English language libretto by the composer which tells a twisted tale of morals and evil womanly power.
works.tagline: Radio opera by Gian Carlo Menotti

works.title: The Passenger
works.premiere_venue: Semi-staged in the Svetlanov Hall of the Moscow International House of Music with musicians of the Stanislavsky Theatre,…
works.summary: The Passenger is a 1968 opera by Mieczysław Weinberg to a Russian libretto by Alexander Medvedev. Medvedev's libretto is based on the 1959 Polish radio play Pasażerka z kabiny 45 (Passenger from Cabin Number 45) by concentration-camp survivor Zofia Posmysz.

works.title: The Star and Death of Joaquin Murieta
works.summary: The Star and Death of Joaquin Murieta is a 1982 Soviet musical drama film directed by Vladimir Grammatikov.

works.title: The White-haired Girl
works.summary: Ma Ke (composer) The White-Haired Girl is a Chinese contemporary classical opera by Ma Ke and others to a Chinese libretto by He Jingzhi and Ding Yi.

works.title: Thésée
works.summary: Thésée is a tragédie en musique, an early type of French opera, in a prologue and five acts with music by Jean-Baptiste Lully and a libretto by Philippe Quinault based on Ovid's Metamorphoses.

works.title: Thoroughly Modern Millie
works.summary: Thoroughly Modern Millie is a musical with music by Jeanine Tesori, lyrics by Dick Scanlan, and a book by Richard Morris and Scanlan.
works.tagline: 2002 musical with music by Jeanine Tesori

works.title: Torquato Tasso
works.summary: Torquato Tasso is a melodramma semiserio, or "semi-serious" opera, in three acts by Gaetano Donizetti and based on the life of the great poet Torquato Tasso.

works.title: Vakula the Smith
works.summary: Vakula the Smith, Op. 14, is a Ukrainian-themed opera in 3 acts, 8 scenes, by Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky. The libretto was written by Yakov Polonsky and is based on Nikolai Gogol's 1832 story "Christmas Eve".

works.title: Viola
works.premiere_venue: main building of the National Theatre in Prague
works.summary: Viola is an unfinished romantic opera by Bedřich Smetana. The libretto was written by Eliška Krásnohorská, and is based on Shakespeare's play Twelfth Night.

works.title: Zanetto
based_on: Emilio Praga's translation of Le Passant (1869) by François Coppée
works.summary: Zanetto is an opera in one act by Pietro Mascagni to an Italian libretto by Giovanni Targioni-Tozzetti and Guido Menasci.
1984 is an opera by the American conductor and composer Lorin Maazel, with a libretto by J. D.

works.title: Alessandro Stradella
works.summary: Alessandro Stradella is a romantic opera (Romantische Oper) in three acts composed by Friedrich von Flotow to a German libretto by "Wilhelm Friedrich" (Friedrich Wilhelm Riese).

works.title: Alina, regina di Golconda
works.summary: Alina, regina di Golconda (Alina, Queen of Golconda) is an opera in two acts by Gaetano Donizetti. The Italian libretto was written by Felice Romani after Michel-Jean Sedaine's French libretto for Pierre-Alexandre Monsigny's ballet-heroique Aline, reine de…

works.title: Amelia Goes to the Ball
works.summary: Amelia al ballo (Amelia Goes to the Ball) is a one-act opera buffa by Gian Carlo Menotti, who set his own Italian libretto.
works.tagline: Opera buffa by Gian Carlo Menotti

works.title: Argippo
works.summary: Argippo is an opera libretto by Domenico Lalli, which in Giovanni Porta's setting premiered in Venice in 1717.

works.title: Arlecchino
works.summary: Arlecchino, oder Die Fenster (Harlequin, or The Windows, BV 270) is a one-act opera with spoken dialogue by Ferruccio Busoni, with a libretto in German, composed in 1913.

works.title: Arshak II
works.summary: Arshak II is the first Armenian classical opera, composed by Tigran Chukhajian to a libretto by Tovmas Terzian, written first in Italian and then translated into Armenian by the librettist.

works.title: Artaxerxes
works.summary: Artaxerxes is an opera in three acts composed by Thomas Arne set to an English adaptation (probably by Arne himself) of Metastasio's 1729 libretto Artaserse.

works.title: Ashiq Qarib
works.summary: Ashig Garib – is the first opera written by Azerbaijani composer Zulfugar Hajibeyov, in 1916, based on motifs of a dastan of the same name.

works.title: Carmen Jones
based_on: Carmen, by Georges Bizet, Henri Meilhac, Ludovic Halévy, Carmen, by Prosper Mérimée
works.summary: Carmen Jones is a 1943 Broadway musical with music by Georges Bizet (orchestrated for Broadway by Robert Russell Bennett) and lyrics and book by Oscar Hammerstein II which was performed at The Broadway Theatre.

works.title: Conchita
based_on: Pierre Louÿs' The Woman and the Puppet
works.summary: Conchita is an opera in four acts and six scenes by composer Riccardo Zandonai. The work uses an Italian language libretto by Maurizio Vaucaire and Carlo Zangarini which is based on Pierre Louÿs' 1898 novel The Woman and the Puppet.

works.title: Crispino e la comare
works.summary: Crispino e la comare o Il medico e la morte (The Cobbler and the Fairy or The Doctor and Death) is an opera written collaboratively by Luigi Ricci and Federico Ricci with an Italian libretto by Francesco Maria Piave.
works.tagline: 1850 Italian opera by Luigi Ricci, Federico Ricci, and Francesco Maria Piave

works.title: Daphnis et Alcimadure
librettists: Mondonville and Claude-Henri de Fusée de Voisenon
works.summary: Daphnis et Alcimadure (in Occitan classical norm, Dafnís e Alcimadura, or according to the original libretto spelling, Daphnis e Alcimaduro) is an opera by the Baroque violinist, conductor and composer Jean-Joseph Cassanéa de Mondonville to a libretto in the…
works.tagline: Opera by Jean-Joseph Cassanéa de Mondonville

works.title: Das Spitzentuch der Königin
works.summary: Das Spitzentuch der Königin (The Queen's Lace Handkerchief) is an operetta by Johann Strauss II. The libretto was by Heinrich Bohrmann-Riegen and Richard Genée and is about the Spanish writer Cervantes.

works.title: Das Wunder der Heliane
works.summary: Das Wunder der Heliane (German for The Miracle of Heliane), Op. 20 is an opera in three acts by Erich Wolfgang Korngold, about "the redemptive power of love over injustice and adversity".

works.title: Der Evangelimann
works.summary: Der Evangelimann (The Evangelist) is an opera in two acts by the Austrian composer Wilhelm Kienzl. The libretto, by the composer, is based on Leopold Florian Meissner's short story "Aus den Berichten eines Polizeikommissärs".

works.title: Der lustige Krieg
works.summary: Der lustige Krieg (The Merry War) is a three-act operetta composed by Johann Strauss II. The work was first performed on 25 November 1881 at the Theater an der Wien.

works.title: Der Templer und die Jüdin
works.summary: Der Templer und die Jüdin is an opera (designated as a Große romantische Oper) in three acts by Heinrich Marschner.

works.title: Didone
works.summary: La Didone is an opera by Francesco Cavalli, set to a libretto by Giovanni Francesco Busenello (later librettist for Claudio Monteverdi).

works.title: Die Harmonie der Welt
works.summary: Die Harmonie der Welt (The Harmony of the World) is an opera in five acts by Paul Hindemith. The German libretto was by the composer.

works.title: Die Herzogin von Chicago
works.summary: Die Herzogin von Chicago (The Duchess of Chicago) is an operetta in two acts, a prologue, and an epilogue. The music was composed by Hungarian composer Emmerich Kálmán with a libretto by Julius Brammer and Alfred Grünwald.

works.title: Die keusche Susanne
works.summary: Die keusche Susanne (Chaste Susanne) is an operetta in three acts by Jean Gilbert. The German libretto was by Georg Okonkowski, based on the 1906 play Le fils à papa by Antony Mars and Maurice Desvallières.

works.title: Die Rheinnixen
works.summary: Die Rheinnixen is a romantic opera in four acts by Jacques Offenbach. The original libretto by Charles-Louis-Étienne Nuitter was translated into German by Alfred von Wolzogen.

works.title: Die toten Augen
works.summary: Die toten Augen (The Dead Eyes) is an opera (called a Bühnendichtung or 'stage poem' by the composer) with a prologue and one act by Eugen d'Albert to a libretto in German by Hanns Heinz Ewers and Marc Henry (Achille Georges d'Ailly-Vaucheret) after Henry's…

works.title: Die Verschworenen
works.summary: Die Verschworenen, also known as Der häusliche Krieg (D 787) is an 1823 one-act singspiel by Franz Schubert after a libretto by Ignaz Franz Castelli with spoken dialogue by the composer.

works.title: Die Vögel
works.summary: Die Vögel (The Birds), Op. 30, is an opera in a prologue and two acts by Walter Braunfels. The libretto, written by the composer, is a free adaptation of Aristophanes' comedy The Birds which was performed at the Dionysos Theatre in Athens in 414 BC.
works.tagline: Opera in two acts by Walter Braunfels

works.title: Dioclesian
works.summary: Dioclesian is an English tragicomic semi-opera in five acts by Henry Purcell to a libretto by Thomas Betterton based on the play The Prophetess, by John Fletcher and Philip Massinger, which in turn was based very loosely on the life of the Emperor Diocletian.

works.title: Doktor Faust
works.summary: Doktor Faust is an opera by Ferruccio Busoni with a German libretto by the composer, based on the myth of Faust.

works.title: Donna Juanita
works.summary: Donna Juanita is a German language operetta in 3 acts by composer Franz von Suppé and librettists Zell and R. Genée.

works.title: Drood
works.summary: The Mystery of Edwin Drood is a mystery musical comedy written by Rupert Holmes based on the unfinished Charles Dickens novel of the same name.

works.title: Edipo re
works.summary: Edipo Re is an opera generally attributed to Ruggero Leoncavallo, although there is some dispute about the authorship.

works.title: Ein Walzertraum
works.summary: Ein Walzertraum (A Waltz Dream) is an operetta by Oscar Straus with a German libretto by Leopold Jacobson and Felix Dörmann, based on the novella Nux, der Prinzgemahl (Nux, the Prince Consort) by Hans Müller-Einigen from his 1905 book Buch der Abenteuer (Book…

works.title: Elegy for Young Lovers
works.summary: Elegy for Young Lovers is an opera in three acts by Hans Werner Henze to an English libretto by W. H.

works.title: Falsettos
works.summary: Falsettos is a sung-through musical with a book by William Finn and James Lapine, and music and lyrics by Finn.
works.tagline: 1992 musical by William Finn and James Lapine

works.title: Farnace
works.summary: Farnace is an opera by Italian composer Antonio Vivaldi, set to a libretto by Antonio Maria Lucchini initially set by Leonardo Vinci during 1724.

works.title: Fernand Cortez
works.summary: Fernand Cortez, ou La conquête du Mexique (Hernán Cortés, or The Conquest of Mexico) is a tragédie en musique in three acts by Gaspare Spontini with a French libretto by Étienne de Jouy and Joseph-Alphonse Esménard.

works.title: Fervaal
works.summary: Fervaal, Op. 40, is an opera (action musicale or lyric drama) in three acts with a prologue by the French composer Vincent d'Indy.

works.title: Follies
works.summary: Follies is a musical with music and lyrics by Stephen Sondheim and a book by James Goldman. The plot centers on a crumbling Broadway theater, now scheduled for demolition, previously home to a musical revue (based on the Ziegfeld Follies).

works.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
works.summary: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes is a musical with a book by Joseph Fields and Anita Loos, lyrics by Leo Robin, and music by Jule Styne, based on the best-selling 1925 novel of the same name by Loos.

works.title: Ghost
works.summary: Ghost is a musical with book and lyrics by Bruce Joel Rubin and music and lyrics by Dave Stewart and Glen Ballard.
works.tagline: Stage musical based on the 1990 movie

works.title: Grisélidis
based_on: play after medieval tale of Griselda
works.summary: Grisélidis is an opera (described as a 'conte lyrique') in three acts and a prologue by Jules Massenet to a French libretto by Armand Silvestre and Eugène Morand.

works.title: Guercœur
works.summary: Guercœur is an opera in three acts by the French composer Albéric Magnard to his own libretto. It was first performed posthumously at the Paris Opéra on 24 April 1931, though it had mostly been written between 1897 and 1901.

works.title: Gwendoline
works.summary: Gwendoline is an opera in two acts and three scenes by the French composer Emmanuel Chabrier, with a libretto by Catulle Mendès.

works.title: I Lituani
works.summary: I Lituani (The Lithuanians) is an opera consisting of a prologue and three acts by Amilcare Ponchielli to an Italian libretto by Antonio Ghislanzoni, based on the historical poem Konrad Wallenrod written by Lithuanian-Polish poet Adam Mickiewicz.

works.title: Il campiello
works.summary: Il campiello (The Little Square) is an opera in three acts by Ermanno Wolf-Ferrari. The libretto was by Mario Ghisalberti, after the famous comedy of the same name written for the 1756 Venetian Carnival by the great Venetian playwright, Carlo Goldoni.

works.title: Il combattimento di Tancredi e Clorinda
works.summary: Il combattimento di Tancredi e Clorinda (The Combat of Tancredi and Clorinda), SV 153, is an operatic scena for three voices by Claudio Monteverdi.

works.title: Il giovedì grasso, o Il nuovo Pourceaugnac
based_on: Monsieur de Pourceaugnac by Molière and Le nouveau Pourceaugnac by Charles-Gaspard Delestre-Poirson and Eugène Scribe
works.summary: Il giovedì grasso is a farsa in one act by Gaetano Donizetti, from a libretto by Domenico Gilardoni. The literal translation of the title is "Fat Thursday", a reference to Carnival celebration.

works.title: Il giuramento
works.summary: Il giuramento (The Oath) is an opera in three acts by Italian composer Saverio Mercadante. The libretto, by Gaetano Rossi, is based on Victor Hugo's 1835 play Angelo, Tyrant of Padua.

works.title: Il Sant'Alessio
works.summary: Il Sant'Alessio (Saint Alexius) is an opera in three acts composed by Stefano Landi in 1631 with a libretto by Giulio Rospigliosi (the future Pope Clement IX).
works.tagline: Opera in three acts composed by Stefano Landi

works.title: Il trionfo dell'onore
works.summary: Il trionfo dell'onore (The Triumph of Honour) is an operatic 'commedia' in three acts by the Italian composer Alessandro Scarlatti, with a libretto by Francesco Antonio Tullio.

works.title: Ivan IV
works.summary: Ivan IV is an opera in five acts by Georges Bizet, with a libretto by Francois-Hippolyte Leroy and Henri Trianon.

works.title: Ivanhoé
works.summary: Ivanhoé is an 1826 pastiche opera in three acts with music by Gioachino Rossini to a French-language libretto by Émile Deschamps and Gabriel-Gustave de Wailly, after Walter Scott's 1819 novel of the same name.

works.title: Jacques Brel is Alive and Well and Living in Paris
librettists: Jacques Brel (French version), Eric Blau (English version), Mort Shuman (English version)
based_on: The original French lyrics and French commentary by Jacques Brel
works.summary: Jacques Brel Is Alive and Well and Living in Paris is a musical revue of the songs of Jacques Brel. Brel's songs were translated into English by Eric Blau and Mort Shuman, who also provided the story.

works.title: Joseph
works.summary: Joseph (also known as Joseph en Égypte) is an opéra comique in three acts by the French composer Étienne Méhul.

works.title: Judith
works.summary: Judith is an opera in five acts, composed by Alexander Serov during 1861–1863. Derived from renditions of the story of Judith from the Old Testament Apocrypha, the Russian libretto, though credited to the composer, has a complicated history.

works.title: Karl V.
works.summary: Karl V. is an opera, described as a Bühnenwerk mit Musik (stage work with music) by Ernst Krenek, his opus 73.

works.title: Keto and Kote
works.summary: Keto and Kote is a comic opera in three acts, by the Georgian composer Victor Dolidze who also wrote the libretto based on Avksenty Tsagareli's 19th-century romantic comedy Khanuma.

works.title: King Priam
works.summary: King Priam is an opera by Michael Tippett, to his own libretto. The story is based on Homer's Iliad, except the birth and childhood of Paris, which are taken from the Fabulae of Hyginus.

works.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
works.summary: Kiss of the Spider Woman is a musical with music by John Kander, lyrics by Fred Ebb, and a book by Terrence McNally.
works.tagline: 1992 musical by John Kander and Fred Ebb

works.title: L'amore dei tre re
works.summary: L'amore dei tre re (The Love of the Three Kings) is an opera in three acts by Italo Montemezzi. Its Italian-language libretto was written by playwright Sem Benelli who based it on his play of the same title.

works.title: L'infedeltà delusa
works.summary: L'infedeltà delusa (Deceit Outwitted), Hob. 28/5, is an operatic burletta per musica in two acts by Joseph Haydn.

works.title: L'isola disabitata
works.summary: L'isola disabitata, Hob. 28/9, is an opera (azione teatrale in due parti) by Joseph Haydn, his tenth opera, written for the Eszterházy court and premiered on 6 December 1779.

works.title: La chanson de Fortunio
works.summary: La chanson de Fortunio (The Song of Fortunio) is a short opéra-comique in one act by Jacques Offenbach with a French libretto by Ludovic Halévy and Hector Crémieux.
works.tagline: Short opéra-comique in one act by Jacques Offenbach

works.title: La costanza trionfante degl'amori e de gl'odii
works.summary: La costanza trionfante degl'amori e degl'odii is a dramma per musica (lit. 'drama for music') by Antonio Vivaldi.

works.title: La fiamma
works.summary: La fiamma is an opera in three acts by Ottorino Respighi to a libretto by Claudio Guastalla based on Hans Wiers-Jenssen's 1908 play Anne Pedersdotter, The Witch.

works.title: La grotta di Trofonio
works.summary: La grotta di Trofonio (Trofonio's Cave) is an opera, described as an opera comica, in two acts (five scenes) composed by Antonio Salieri to an Italian libretto by Giovanni Battista Casti.

works.title: La mère coupable
works.summary: La Mère coupable (The Guilty Mother) is an opera in three acts, Op. 412, by Darius Milhaud to a libretto by Madeleine Milhaud after the 1792 play, the third in Beaumarchais' Figaro trilogy.

works.title: La romanziera e l'uomo nero
works.summary: La romanziera e l'uomo nero (also known as La romanzesca e l'uomo nero) is an 1831 one-act farsa with music by Gaetano Donizetti and an Italian libretto by Domenico Gilardoni, possibly based on the 1819 play La donna dei romanzi by Augusto Bon.

works.title: Le docteur Miracle
works.summary: Le docteur Miracle (Doctor Miracle) is an opérette in one act by the French composer Georges Bizet. The libretto, by Léon Battu and Ludovic Halévy, is based on Sheridan's play Saint Patrick's Day.

works.title: Le donne curiose
works.summary: Le donne curiose is an opera in three acts by Ermanno Wolf-Ferrari to a text by Luigi Sugana after Carlo Goldoni's play of the same name.

works.title: Le mage
works.summary: Le Mage ("the Magus") is an opera in five acts by Jules Massenet to a French libretto by Jean Richepin. It was first performed at the Paris Opéra in Paris on 16 March 1891 in costumes by Charles Bianchini and sets by Auguste Alfred Rubé, Philippe Chaperon and…

works.title: Le portrait de Manon
works.summary: Le portrait de Manon is an opéra comique in one act by Jules Massenet to a French libretto by Georges Boyer. It is related to Massenet's 1884 opera Manon, widely regarded to be his masterpiece.

works.title: Le violoneux
works.summary: Le violoneux is a one-act operetta (« légende bretonne » - Breton legend) by Jacques Offenbach to a French libretto by Eugène Mestépès and Émile Chevalet, first performed in 1855.

works.title: Les barbares
works.summary: Les barbares is a 1901 tragédie lyrique in 3 acts by Camille Saint-Saëns to a libretto by Victorien Sardou and Pierre-Barthélemy Gheusi.

works.title: Les deux aveugles
works.summary: Les deux aveugles is an 1855 one-act French bouffonerie musicale (operetta) by Jacques Offenbach. The libretto was written by Jules Moinaux and was a condensation of his 3-act Les musiciens ambulants.

works.title: Les deux journées, ou Le porteur de l'eau
works.summary: Les deux journées, ou Le porteur d'eau (The Two Days, or The Water Carrier) is an opera in three acts by Luigi Cherubini with a libretto by Jean-Nicolas Bouilly.

works.title: Les diamants de la couronne
works.summary: Les diamants de la couronne (The Crown Diamonds) is an opéra comique by the French composer Daniel Auber, first performed by the Opéra-Comique at the second Salle Favart in Paris on 6 March 1841.

works.title: Lo frate 'nnamorato
works.summary: Lo frate 'nnamorato is a three-act commedia per musica (a form of opera buffa) by Giovanni Battista Pergolesi, to a Neapolitan libretto by Gennaro Antonio Federico, first performed in 1732.

works.title: Lodoletta
works.summary: Lodoletta is a dramma lirico or lyric opera in three acts by Pietro Mascagni. The libretto is by Giovacchino Forzano, and is based on the novel Two Little Wooden Shoes by Ouida (pseudonym of Marie Louise de la Ramée).

works.title: Mala vita
works.summary: Mala vita (Wretched Life) is an opera in three acts composed by Umberto Giordano to a libretto by Nicola Daspuro adapted from Salvatore Di Giacomo's and Goffredo Cognetti's verismo play of the same name.
works.tagline: Opera by Umberto Giordano with libretto by Nicola Daspuro

works.title: Manru
works.summary: Manru is an opera (lyrical drama) in three acts, music by Ignacy Jan Paderewski composed to the libretto by Alfred Nossig based on the novel A Hut Behind the Village (1854) by Józef Ignacy Kraszewski.

works.title: María de Buenos Aires
works.summary: María de Buenos Aires is a tango opera (tango operita) with music by Astor Piazzolla and libretto by Horacio Ferrer that premiered at the Sala Planeta in Buenos Aires on 8 May 1968.
works.tagline: 20th C. tango opera by Astor Piazzolla

works.title: Maria Tudor
works.summary: Maria Tudor is an opera in four acts composed by Antônio Carlos Gomes to an Italian-language libretto by Emilio Praga (completed by Arrigo Boito).

works.title: Mean Girls
works.summary: Mean Girls is a rock musical with a book by Tina Fey, lyrics by Nell Benjamin, and music by Jeff Richmond. It is based on the 2004 film by Mark Waters, which was also written by Fey and was in turn inspired by Rosalind Wiseman's 2002 book Queen Bees and…

works.title: The Mother of Us All
works.summary: The Mother of Us All is a two-act opera composed by Virgil Thomson to a libretto by Gertrude Stein. Thomson and Stein met in 1945 to begin the writing process, almost twenty years after their first collaborative project, the opera Four Saints in Three Acts.

works.title: The Noblewoman Vera Sheloga
works.summary: The Noblewoman Vera Sheloga is an opera in one act by Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov. Rimsky-Korsakov wrote the libretto, which he based on the first act of the play The Maid of Pskov by Lev Alexandrovich Mey.

works.title: The Power of the Fiend
based_on: Live Not as You Would Like To
works.summary: The Power of the Fiend is an opera in five acts by Alexander Serov, composed during 1867-1871. The libretto is derived from a drama by Alexander Ostrovsky from 1854 entitled Live Not As You Would Like To, But As God Commands.

works.title: The Prodigal Son
works.summary: The Prodigal Son is a music drama by Benjamin Britten with a libretto by William Plomer. Based on the Biblical story of the Prodigal Son, this was Britten's third "parable for church performance", after Curlew River and The Burning Fiery Furnace.

works.title: The Prom
works.summary: The Prom is a musical with music by Matthew Sklar, lyrics by Chad Beguelin, and a book by Bob Martin and Beguelin, based on an original concept by Jack Viertel.

works.title: The Saint of Bleecker Street
works.summary: The Saint of Bleecker Street is an opera in three acts by Gian Carlo Menotti to an original English libretto by the composer.

works.title: The Sorcerer
works.summary: The Sorcerer is a two-act comic opera, with a libretto by W. S.

works.title: The Tempest
works.summary: The Tempest is an opera by English composer Thomas Adès with a libretto in English by Meredith Oakes based on the play The Tempest by William Shakespeare.

works.title: Tina
works.summary: Tina: The Tina Turner Musical is a jukebox musical featuring the music of Tina Turner and depicting her life from her humble beginnings in Nutbush, Tennessee, to her transformation into a rock 'n roll superstar.

works.title: Trouble in Tahiti
works.summary: Trouble in Tahiti is a one-act opera in seven scenes composed by Leonard Bernstein with an English libretto by the composer.

works.title: Verbum nobile
works.summary: Verbum nobile (The Word of a nobleman) is a one-act comic opera by Polish national composer Stanisław Moniuszko written to a libretto by Jan Chęciński, and set in 18th century Poland before foreign partitions of the country.

works.title: Véronique
works.summary: Véronique is an opéra comique in three acts with music by André Messager and words by Georges Duval and Albert Vanloo.

works.title: Volo di notte
works.summary: Volo di notte (Night Flight) is a one-act opera composed by Luigi Dallapiccola to an Italian libretto he wrote based on the novel Vol de nuit by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry.

works.title: Von heute auf morgen
works.summary: Von heute auf morgen (From Today to Tomorrow or From One Day to the Next) is a one-act opera composed by Arnold Schoenberg, to a German libretto by "Max Blonda", the pseudonym of Gertrud Schoenberg, the composer's wife.

works.title: Whistle Down the Wind
works.summary: Whistle Down the Wind is a musical with music composed by Andrew Lloyd Webber, who also co-wrote its book with Patricia Knop and Gale Edwards, and lyrics by Jim Steinman.

works.title: Xerse
works.summary: Il Xerse, usually written Xerse, is an Italian opera by Francesco Cavalli (specifically, a dramma per musica) about Xerxes I.

works.title: Zhenitba
works.premiere_venue: Great Hall of the Nobility, Moscow
works.summary: Zhenitba is an unfinished opera begun in 1868 by Modest Mussorgsky to his own libretto based on Nikolai Gogol's comedy Marriage.

works.title: Zoroastre
works.summary: Zoroastre (Zoroaster) is an opera by Jean-Philippe Rameau, first performed on 5 December 1749 by the Opéra in the first Salle du Palais-Royal in Paris.

works.title: & Juliet
works.summary: & Juliet is a 2019 jukebox musical featuring the music of Swedish pop songwriter Max Martin, with a book by David West Read, in which Anne Hathaway negotiates with her husband, William Shakespeare, to change the ending to Romeo and Juliet so that Juliet does…

works.title: 1000 Airplanes on the Roof
works.summary: 1000 Airplanes on the Roof is a melodrama in one act with music by Philip Glass, text by David Henry Hwang, and projections by Jerome Sirlin.

13 is a musical with music and lyrics by Jason Robert Brown and book by Dan Elish and Robert Horn. Following a move from New York City to small-town Indiana, young Evan Goldman grapples with his parents' divorce, prepares for his impending Bar Mitzvah, and…
works.tagline: Musical by Jason Robert Brown, Dan Elish, and Robert Horn

works.summary: 1776 is a musical with music and lyrics by Sherman Edwards and a book by Peter Stone. The show is based on the events leading up to the signing of the Declaration of Independence, telling a story of the efforts of John Adams to persuade his colleagues to vote…
works.tagline: 1969 musical by Sherman Edwards and Peter Stone

works.title: A Streetcar Named Desire
works.summary: A Streetcar Named Desire is an opera composed by André Previn in 1995 with a libretto by Philip Littell. It is based on the play of the same name by Tennessee Williams.

works.title: Abai
works.summary: Abai is an opera in two acts, created by Akhmet Zhubanov and Latif Khamidi, on a libretto of Mukhtar Auezov, inspired by a slice of the life of the poet Abai Qunanbaiuli.

works.title: Abesalom da Eteri
works.summary: Abesalom da Eteri is an opera by the Georgian composer Zacharia Paliashvili and librettist Petre Mirianashvili based on a medieval Georgian folk poem Eteriani.

works.title: Acante et Céphise
works.summary: Acante et Céphise, ou La sympathie is an opera by Jean-Philippe Rameau, first performed on 19 November 1751 at the Opéra in Paris.

works.title: Adriano in Siria
works.summary: Adriano in Siria is an opera by Giovanni Battista Pergolesi setting Metastasio's libretto of the same name. It was the third of his four opere serie, premiered at Teatro San Bartolomeo in Naples on 25 October 1734.

works.title: Al gran sole carico d'amore
based_on: Plays by Bertolt Brecht, among others
works.summary: Al gran sole carico d'amore (In the Bright Sunshine Heavy with Love) is an opera (designated as an 'azione scenica') with music by Luigi Nono, based mainly on plays by Bertolt Brecht, but also incorporating texts of Fidel Castro, Che Guevara, Karl Marx, and…

works.title: Alessandro nelle Indie
works.summary: Alessandro nelle Indie (Alexander in India) is an opera seria in two acts by Giovanni Pacini to a libretto by Andrea Leone Tottola and Giovanni Schmidt, based on Alessandro nell'Indie by Pietro Metastasio.
works.tagline: Opera seria in two acts by Giovanni Pacini

works.title: Amadis
works.summary: Amadis is an opera in three acts with prologue by Jules Massenet to a French libretto by Jules Claretie based on the Spanish knight-errantry romance Amadis de Gaula, originally of Portuguese origin, by Garci Rodríguez de Montalvo.

works.title: Aniara
works.summary: Aniara is an opera in two acts by Karl-Birger Blomdahl, with a libretto by Erik Lindegren based on the poem Aniara by Harry Martinson, that was premiered at the Royal Swedish Opera on 31 May 1959.

works.title: Antigona
works.summary: Antigona (Antigone) is an opera in three acts in Italian by the composer Tommaso Traetta. The libretto, by Marco Coltellini, is based on the tragedy Antigone by Sophocles.

works.title: Antigone
works.summary: Antigone is an opera (tragédie musicale) in three acts by Arthur Honegger to a French libretto by Jean Cocteau based on the tragedy Antigone by Sophocles.

works.title: Asrael

works.title: Attilio Regolo
works.summary: Attilio Regolo is an Italian-language opera seria by Johann Adolph Hasse based on the story of Marcus Atilius Regulus, a Roman general taken prisoner in Carthage who elects death rather than ransom.

works.title: Babes in Toyland
works.summary: Babes in Toyland is an operetta composed by Victor Herbert with a libretto by Glen MacDonough, which wove together various characters from Mother Goose nursery rhymes into a musical extravaganza.
works.tagline: Operetta by Victor Herbert and Glen MacDonough

works.title: Bagatelle
works.summary: Bagatelle is a one-act opéra-comique by Jacques Offenbach, with a French libretto by Hector Crémieux and Ernest Blum.

works.title: Barkouf
works.summary: Barkouf is an opéra bouffe in three acts premiered in 1860 with music composed by Jacques Offenbach to a French libretto by Eugène Scribe and Henry Boisseaux, after Abbé Blanchet, the fourth of his Contes Orientaux entitled Barkouf et Mani.

works.title: Barnum
based_on: The life of P. T. Barnum
works.summary: Barnum is an American musical with a book by Mark Bramble, lyrics by Michael Stewart, and music by Cy Coleman.

works.title: Bezauberndes Fräulein
based_on: La petite chocolatière by Paul Gavault
works.summary: Bezauberndes Fräulein (The Charming Young Lady) is a musical comedy in four scenes, similar in style to an operetta.
works.tagline: Musical comedy in four scenes by Ralph Benatzky

works.title: Bion
works.summary: Bion is an opera by the French composer Étienne Méhul. It takes the form of a comédie en vers mêlée de musique (an opéra comique) in one act.

works.title: Bluthochzeit
works.summary: Bluthochzeit (Blood Wedding) is an opera (lyrische Tragödie) in two acts by Wolfgang Fortner. The libretto, also by Fortner, is based on Enrique Beck's German translation of García Lorca's 1933 play Bodas de sangre.

works.title: Brokeback Mountain
works.summary: Brokeback Mountain is an opera by American composer Charles Wuorinen, with a libretto in English by Annie Proulx, based on her 1997 short story "Brokeback Mountain".

works.title: Buonanotte Bettina
works.summary: Buonanotte Bettina (lit. 'Good night Bettina') is a play by Italian playwrights Pietro Garinei and Sandro Giovannini.

works.title: By Jeeves
based_on: Jeeves stories, by P. G. Wodehouse
works.summary: By Jeeves, originally Jeeves, is a musical with music by Andrew Lloyd Webber, and lyrics and book by Alan Ayckbourn.

works.title: Cabin in the Sky
works.summary: Cabin in the Sky is a musical with music by Vernon Duke, book by Lynn Root, and lyrics by John Latouche. The musical opened on Broadway in 1940.

works.title: Cagliostro in Wien

works.title: Can-Can
works.summary: Can-Can is a musical with music and lyrics by Cole Porter, and a book by Abe Burrows. The story concerns the showgirls of the Montmartre dance halls during the 1890s.

works.title: Catone in Utica
works.summary: Catone in Utica is a 1728 opera by Leonardo Vinci. It was the original setting of Metastasio's libretto of that name.

works.title: Céphale et Procris
works.summary: Céphale et Procris (Cephalus and Procris) is an opera by the French composer Élisabeth Jacquet de La Guerre. It takes the form of a tragédie en musique in five acts with an allegorical prologue.

works.title: Christophe Colomb
works.summary: Christophe Colomb (Christopher Columbus) is an opera in two parts by the French composer Darius Milhaud. The poet Paul Claudel wrote the libretto based on his own play about the life of Christopher Columbus, Le Livre de Christophe Colomb.

works.title: Chu Chin Chow

works.tagline: Musical comedy by Oscar Asche and Frederic Norton

works.title: Ciboulette
works.summary: Ciboulette is a French opérette in three acts, music by Reynaldo Hahn, libretto by Robert de Flers and Francis de Croisset, first performed at the Théâtre des Variétés, in Paris, on 7 April 1923.

works.title: Cinderella
works.summary: Rodgers + Hammerstein's Cinderella is a musical in two acts with music by Richard Rodgers, lyrics by Oscar Hammerstein II, and a book by Douglas Carter Beane based partly on Hammerstein's 1957 television adaptation.
works.tagline: Musical by Rodgers, Hammerstein and Beane (2013 adaptation)

works.title: Clari
works.summary: Clari is an opera semiseria in three acts by Fromental Halévy, to an Italian libretto by Pietro Giannone. It was first produced at the Théâtre-Italien in Paris on 19 December 1828.

works.title: Cleofide
works.summary: Cleofide (Cleophis) is an opera seria in three acts by Johann Adolf Hasse. The Italian libretto was adapted from Metastasio's Alessandro nell'Indie by Michelangelo Boccardi.

works.title: Cléopâtre
works.summary: Cléopâtre is an opera in four acts by Jules Massenet to a French libretto by Louis Payen. It was first performed at the Opéra de Monte-Carlo on 23 February 1914, nearly two years after Massenet's death.

works.title: Croesus
works.summary: Der hochmütige, gestürzte und wieder erhabene Croesus (The Proud, Overthrown and Again Exalted Croesus) is a three-act opera (described as a "Singe-Spiel") composed by Reinhard Keiser.

works.title: Croquefer, ou Le dernier des paladins
works.summary: Croquefer, ou Le dernier des paladins is a one-act opéra bouffe by Jacques Offenbach to a French libretto by Adolphe Jaime and Étienne Tréfeu, first performed in 1857 in Paris.

works.title: Danton's Death

works.title: Démophoon
works.summary: Démophoon (sometimes spelt Démophon) is an opera by the composer Luigi Cherubini, first performed at the Académie Royale de Musique (the Paris Opera) on 2 December 1788.

works.summary: Der Bäbu (The Baboo) is a Comic opera in three acts by Heinrich Marschner. The German libretto by Wilhelm August Wohlbrück (Marschner's brother-in-law) is based on the book The Baboo and Other Tales Descriptive of Society in India, Smith, Elder, and Co.…

works.title: Der Kreidekreis

works.title: Der Obersteiger
works.summary: The Mine Foreman is an operetta composed by Carl Zeller with a libretto by Ludwig Held and Moritz West. It premiered on 5 January 1894 at the Theater an der Wien in Vienna.

works.title: Der Prinz von Homburg

works.title: Der Roland von Berlin
works.summary: Der Roland von Berlin is an opera in four acts by composer Ruggero Leoncavallo. The work uses a German-language libretto by Leoncavallo which is based on Willibald Alexis's 1840 historical novel of the same name.

works.title: Der Schatzgräber

works.summary: Didone abbandonata is an 1823 opera in two acts by Saverio Mercadante to a libretto by Andrea Leone Tottola after Metastasio's Didone abbandonata.

works.title: Die blaue Mazur
works.summary: Die Blaue Mazur (The Blue Mazurka) is an operetta by Franz Lehár. The libretto was written by Bela Jenbach and Leo Stein.

works.title: Die Brautwahl
works.summary: Die Brautwahl (The Bridal Choice) is a "comic-fantastic" opera in three acts and an epilogue by Ferruccio Busoni.

works.title: Die Verurteilung des Lukullus
works.summary: Die Verurteilung des Lukullus (The Condemnation of Lucullus) is an opera by Paul Dessau to a libretto by the German dramatist Bertolt Brecht.

works.title: Die Zaubergeige
works.summary: Die Zaubergeige is a 1935 opera by Werner Egk to a libretto by Ludwig Strecker after Count Franz Pocci. Egk revised the opera in 1954.

works.summary: Die Zwillingsbrüder (The Twin Brothers, D. 647) is a one-act Singspiel (sometimes also described as a Posse mit Gesang) composed by Franz Schubert in 1819 on a libretto by Georg Ernst von Hofmann.

works.summary: Dimitrij is a Czech-language grand opera in four acts by Antonín Dvořák (Op. 64, B. 127), set to a libretto by Marie Červinková-Riegrová, with a plot derived from Ferdinand Mikovec's Dimitr Ivanovič, itself based upon Friedrich Schiller's incomplete Demetrius.

works.title: Drot og marsk

works.title: Echo et Narcisse
works.summary: Écho et Narcisse (Echo and Narcissus) is a 1779 drame lyrique in three acts, the last original opera written by Christoph Willibald Gluck, his sixth for the French stage.

works.title: Edmea
works.summary: Edmea is an 1886 opera in three acts by Alfredo Catalani to a libretto by Antonio Ghislanzoni.

works.title: Emma di Resburgo

works.title: Erismena

works.summary: Ezio is an opera seria from the Early Classical Period in three acts composed by Christoph Willibald Gluck, staged in 1750 and revised in 1763.

works.title: Faniska
works.summary: Faniska is an opera eroica in three acts by Luigi Cherubini. The German libretto, by Joseph Sonnleithner, is based on the melodrama Les mines de Pologne (1803) by René-Charles Guilbert de Pixérécourt.

works.title: Farewell My Concubine
works.summary: The Hegemon-King Bids His Lady Farewell, also known as Farewell My Concubine, is a traditional Peking opera. It was initially performed by Yang Xiaolou and Shang Xiaoyun in 1918 in Beijing.

works.title: Feast in Time of Plague

works.title: Flammen
works.summary: Flammen (Flames) is an opera in two acts and ten scenes composed by Erwin Schulhoff, his only opera. The original libretto in Czech was written by Karel Josef Beneš.

works.title: Gambämark

works.title: Giove in Argo
works.summary: Giove in Argo (Jupiter in Argos, HWV A14) is an Italian opera by George Frideric Handel. It is one of Handel's three pasticcio works made up of music and arias from his previous operas.

works.title: Giulio Sabino

works.title: L'abandon d'Ariane

works.title: Feramors
works.summary: Feramors is an opera in three (first version) or two (second version) acts by Anton Rubinstein to a libretto by Julius Rodenberg.

works.title: Festival of the Lion King
works.summary: There have been seven theme park live adaptations of The Lion King at Disney Parks since the Disney animated feature film The Lion King was released by Walt Disney Animation Studios in 1994.

works.title: Fête Galante
works.summary: Fête Galante is an opera in one act composed by Ethel Smyth to an English-language libretto by Smyth and Edward Shanks based on Maurice Baring's 1909 short story of the same name.

works.title: Flammen
works.summary: Flammen (Flames) is a one-act opera by Franz Schreker, on a libretto by Dora Leen, pseudonym of Dora Pollak (born 23 October 1880, died Auschwitz c. 1942).

works.title: Fleur-de-Thé
works.summary: Fleur-de-Thé is a three-act opéra bouffe with music by Charles Lecocq and words by Alfred Duru and Henri Chivot.

works.title: Flis
works.summary: Flis (Raftsman) is a Polish-language opera in one act by Stanisław Moniuszko to a libretto by Stanisław Bogusławski.

works.title: Footloose
works.summary: Footloose is a 1998 musical based on the 1984 film of the same name. The music is by Tom Snow (among others), the lyrics by Dean Pitchford (with additional lyrics by Kenny Loggins), and the book by Pitchford and Walter Bobbie.

works.title: Fosse
works.summary: Fosse is a three-act musical revue showcasing the choreography of Bob Fosse. The musical was conceived by Richard Maltby Jr., Chet Walker, and Ann Reinking.

works.title: Fra i due litiganti il terzo gode
works.summary: Fra i due litiganti il terzo gode (While Two Dispute, the Third Enjoys) is a dramma giocoso in two acts by Giuseppe Sarti.

works.title: Francesca da Rimini
works.summary: Francesca da Rimini is an 1831 opera by Saverio Mercadante to a libretto by Felice Romani based on Silvio Pellico's play which had already been set twice and ultimately was set by fifteen composers.

works.title: Funny Face
works.summary: Funny Face is a 1927 musical composed by George Gershwin, with lyrics by Ira Gershwin, and book by Fred Thompson and Paul Gerard Smith.

works.title: Geneviève de Brabant
works.summary: Geneviève de Brabant is an opéra bouffe, or operetta, by Jacques Offenbach, first performed in Paris in 1859. The plot is based on the medieval legend of Genevieve of Brabant.

works.title: Gilgamesh
works.summary: Gilgameš is an opera in three acts by Rudolf Brucci. The libretto by Arsenije Arsa Milošević is based on the Mesopotamian Epic of Gilgamesh.

works.title: Gismonda
works.summary: Gismonda is a 1919 French-language grand opera in three acts by Henry Février to a libretto by Henri Caïn and Louis Payen based on the 1894 play Gismonda by Victorien Sardou.

works.title: Gloria
works.summary: Gloria is a tragic opera in three acts by Francesco Cilea with an Italian libretto by Arturo Colautti. A variation on the Romeo and Juliet story and set in 14th century Siena, the libretto is based on Victorien Sardou's 1874 play La Haine (Hatred).

works.title: Goplana
works.summary: Goplana is an 1896 Polish opera by Władysław Żeleński, to a Polish libretto by Ludomil German based on the 1839 drama Balladyna by Juliusz Słowacki.

works.title: Guido et Ginevra
works.summary: Guido et Ginevra, ou La Peste de Florence is a grand opera in five acts by Fromental Halévy to a libretto by Eugène Scribe.

works.title: Handel's lost Hamburg operas
works.summary: In 1703, the 18-year-old composer George Frideric Handel took up residence in Hamburg, Germany, where he remained until 1706.
works.tagline: Operas of 1703–1706 that have been lost

works.title: Hélène
works.summary: Hélène is a poème lyrique or opera in one act by composer Camille Saint-Saëns. It is the first opera for which Saint-Saëns wrote his own French libretto, which is based on the classic story of Helen of Troy and Paris from Greek mythology.
works.tagline: Opera in one act by Camille Saint-Saëns

works.title: Horatius Coclès
works.summary: Horatius Coclès is an opera in one act and nine scenes (styled an acte lyrique) by the French composer Étienne Nicolas Méhul with a libretto by Antoine-Vincent Arnault.

works.title: Hoy no me puedo levantar
works.summary: Hoy no me puedo levantar (Today I Can't Get up) is a Spanish jukebox musical, with music and lyrics by José María Cano and Nacho Cano, former members of the band Mecano.
works.tagline: Musical by Nacho Cano , José María Cano

works.title: If/Then
works.summary: If/Then is a musical with a libretto by Brian Yorkey and a theatrical score by Tom Kitt, directed by Michael Greif.
works.tagline: Musical by Brian Yorkey and Tom Kitt

works.title: Ifigenia in Tauride
works.summary: Ifigenia in Tauride is an opera in three acts by Gian Francesco de Majo to a libretto by Mattia Verazi. It was commissioned by Elector Palatine Carl Theodor, and premiered in 1764.
works.tagline: 18th-century Italian opera by Gian Francesco de Majo

works.title: Il curioso indiscreto
works.summary: Il curioso indiscreto ("The Imprudent Curious Man"), is an opera (dramma giocoso) in three acts composed by Pasquale Anfossi.

works.title: Il Flaminio
works.summary: Il Flaminio is a 1735 opera buffa by Giovanni Battista Pergolesi to a Neapolitan libretto by Gennaro Antonio Federico, first performed at the Teatro Nuovo, Naples.

works.title: Il Pompeo
works.summary: Il Pompeo is a dramma per musica in three acts by composer Alessandro Scarlatti. Written in 1682 when Scarlatti was 22 years old, it was his fourth opera and first dramatic work on a serious and grand subject.

works.title: Il proscritto
works.summary: Il proscritto (The Proscribed Man) is an 1842 opera by Saverio Mercadante to a libretto by Salvadore Cammarano based on the 1839 play Le proscrit by Frédéric Soulié.

works.title: Il re
works.summary: Il re (The king) is a novella or opera in one act and three scenes by composer Umberto Giordano to an Italian libretto by Giovacchino Forzano.
works.tagline: Single Act Opera by Umberto Giordano

works.title: Il ricco d'un giorno
works.summary: Il ricco d'un giorno is a dramma giocoso in three acts composed by Antonio Salieri. The Italian libretto was by Lorenzo Da Ponte after a work by Giovanni Bertati.

works.title: Il ritorno di Don Calandrino
works.summary: Il ritorno di Don Calandrino (The Return of Don Calandrino), also known as Armidoro e Laurina, is an intermezzo in two acts by Domenico Cimarosa with an Italian libretto presumably written by Giuseppe Petrosellini.

works.title: Innocence
works.summary: Innocence is an opera in five acts by the Finnish composer Kaija Saariaho. The libretto was written in Finnish by Sofi Oksanen and translated/adapted by Aleksi Barrière.
works.tagline: 2021 opera in five acts by Kaija Saariaho

works.title: Irische Legende
based_on: The Countess Kathleen and Various Legends and Lyrics
works.summary: Irische Legende (Irish Legend) is a 1955 opera by Werner Egk who also wrote the libretto after the 1892/1899 verse drama The Countess Cathleen by W.

works.title: Issé
works.summary: Issé is an operatic pastorale héroïque by the French composer André Cardinal Destouches. Initially it was in three acts.

works.title: Ivanhoe
works.summary: Ivanhoe is a romantic opera in three acts based on the 1819 novel by Sir Walter Scott, with music by Sir Arthur Sullivan and a libretto by Julian Sturgis.

works.title: Jagged Little Pill
works.summary: Jagged Little Pill is a jukebox musical with music by Alanis Morissette and Glen Ballard, lyrics by Morissette, and book by Diablo Cody, with additional music by Michael Farrell and Guy Sigsworth.

works.title: Jakob Lenz
works.summary: Jakob Lenz is a one-act chamber opera by Wolfgang Rihm, written 1977–78 to a libretto by Michael Fröhling after Georg Büchner's 1836 novella Lenz which in turn is based on an incident in the life of the German poet Jakob Michael Reinhold Lenz.

works.title: Jephtas Gelübde
based_on: story of Jephthah in the Book of Judges
works.summary: Jephtas Gelübde (The vow of Jephthah) was the first opera composed by Giacomo Meyerbeer. The libretto, which is elaborated from the story of Jephthah from the Book of Judges, was by Aloys Schreiber.

works.title: Julie
works.summary: Julie is a one-act chamber opera written by the Belgian composer Philippe Boesmans, who was composer-in-residence of the Brussels opera house, La Monnaie.

works.title: Julien ou La Vie du poète
works.summary: Julien, ou La vie du poète (Julien, or The Poet's Life) is a poème lyrique, or opera, by composer Gustave Charpentier.

works.title: Karabakhname
works.summary: Karabakhname is an opera by Franghiz Ali-Zadeh. The libretto is by philologist-scientist Nargiz Pashayeva.

works.title: King and Charcoal Burner
works.summary: King and Charcoal Burner, Op. 14 (B. 21, revised under B. 151), is a Czech comic opera in three acts, divided into 23 scenes, with music by Antonín Dvořák.

works.title: König Hirsch
based_on: Il re cervo by Carlo Gozzi
works.summary: König Hirsch (in English, The Stag King) is an opera in three acts by Hans Werner Henze to a German libretto by Heinz von Cramer after Il re cervo, a theatrical fable (1762) by Carlo Gozzi.

works.title: Krútňava
works.summary: Krútňava (abroad staged as The Whirlpool or Katrena after the main female role) is an opera in six scenes by Eugen Suchoň written in the 1940s to a libretto by the composer and Štefan Hoza, based on a novella, Za vyšným mlynom (Beyond the Upper Mill) by Milo…

works.title: L'amor coniugale
works.summary: L'amor coniugale (Conjugal Love) is an opera in one act by Simon Mayr set to an Italian libretto by Gaetano Rossi.

works.title: L'ancêtre
works.summary: L'ancêtre ("The Ancestor") is a 1905 drame lyrique in 3 acts by Camille Saint-Saëns to a libretto by Lucien Augé de Lassus (1841-1914).

works.title: L'Armida immaginaria
works.summary: L'Armida immaginaria is a dramma giocoso in three acts by composer Domenico Cimarosa with an Italian libretto by Giuseppe Palomba.

works.title: L'attaque du moulin
works.summary: L'attaque du moulin (The Attack on the Mill) is a drame lyrique (opera) in four acts by the French composer Alfred Bruneau.

works.title: L'ebreo
works.summary: L'ebreo (The Hebrew) is an 1855 opera by Giuseppe Apolloni to a libretto by Antonio Boni adapted from Edward Bulwer-Lytton's novella Leila; or, The Siege of Granada of 1838.

works.title: L'éclair
works.summary: L'Éclair (The Lightning Flash) is an opéra comique in 3 acts by Fromental Halévy to a libretto by Jules-Henri Vernoy de Saint-Georges.
works.tagline: Opéra comique in 3 acts by Fromental Halévy

works.title: L'olimpiade
works.summary: For Giovanni Battista Pergolesi's L'Olimpiade, see L'Olimpiade (Pergolesi) L'Olimpiade is an opera in three acts by Baldassare Galuppi in the opera seria style, based on the original libretto of the same name by Pietro Metastasio.

works.title: La Basoche
works.summary: La Basoche is an opéra comique in three acts, with music by André Messager and words by Albert Carré. The opera is set in Paris in 1514 and depicts the complications that arise when the elected "king" of the student guild, the Basoche, is mistaken for King…
works.tagline: Opéra comique by André Messager and Albert Carré

works.title: La bonne d'enfant
works.summary: La bonne d'enfant (The Nanny) is an opérette bouffe, in one act by Jacques Offenbach to a French libretto by Eugène Bercioux.

works.title: La campana sommersa
works.summary: La campana sommersa (The Sunken Bell) is an opera in four acts by Italian composer Ottorino Respighi. Its libretto is by Claudio Guastalla, based on the play Die versunkene Glocke by German author Gerhart Hauptmann.

works.title: La capricciosa corretta
works.summary: La capricciosa corretta (The capricious woman reformed) is a comic opera (commedia per musica) in two acts composed by Vicente Martín y Soler.
works.tagline: Opera by Vicente Martín y Soler

works.title: La chute de la maison Usher
works.summary: La chute de la maison Usher (The Fall of the House of Usher) is an unfinished opera in one act (divided into two scenes) by Claude Debussy to his own libretto, based on Edgar Allan Poe's 1839 short story "The Fall of the House of Usher".

works.title: La cifra
works.summary: La cifra is an opera by Antonio Salieri in two acts, set to an Italian libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte. The work, a dramma giocoso, is set in Scotland, and was written for Adriana Ferrarese del Bene, the first Fiordiligi in Mozart's Così fan tutte.

works.title: La Clementina
works.premiere_venue: Palace Puerta de la Vega, Madrid
works.summary: Clementina, although wrongly and popularly known as La Clementina, is a zarzuela in two acts by Luigi Boccherini.

works.title: La fausse esclave
works.summary: La fausse esclave (The False Slave) is an opéra comique in one act by Christoph Willibald Gluck. Its French-language libretto based on Louis Anseaume and Pierre-Augustin Lefèvre de Marcouville's libretto for La fausse aventurière (The False Adventuress), an…

works.title: La fiera di Venezia
works.summary: La fiera di Venezia (The fair in Venice) is a three-act opera buffa, described as a commedia per musica, by Antonio Salieri, set to an Italian libretto by Giovanni Gastone Boccherini (brother of the composer Luigi Boccherini).

works.title: La guirlande
works.summary: La guirlande is an opera by the French composer Jean-Philippe Rameau with a libretto by Jean-François Marmontel.

works.title: La jolie parfumeuse
works.summary: La jolie parfumeuse is an opéra comique in three acts of 1873 with music by Jacques Offenbach. The French libretto was by Hector Crémieux and Ernest Blum.

works.title: La La Lucille
librettists: Arthur J. Jackson, Buddy DeSylva, Lou Paley, Irving Caesar
works.summary: La La Lucille is a musical with a book by Fred Jackson, primary lyrics by Arthur J. Jackson and Buddy DeSylva, additional lyrics by Lou Paley and Irving Caesar, and music by George Gershwin.

works.title: La magicienne
works.summary: La magicienne (The Sorceress) is a grand opera in five acts composed by Fromental Halévy. The libretto by Jules-Henri Vernoy de Saint-Georges is based on stories surrounding the European folk figure Melusine, especially Coudrette's 15th-century Roman de…
works.tagline: Grand opera in five acts composed by Fromental Halévy

works.title: La maison du docteur
works.summary: La maison du docteur is an opéra comique in one act by Georges Bizet with a French libretto by Henry Boisseaux.

works.title: La marquise de Brinvilliers
works.summary: La marquise de Brinvilliers is an operatic 'drame lyrique' that was written as a collaborative effort on the part of nine composers.
works.tagline: 1831 opera by nine French and Italian composers

works.title: La Montagne noire
works.summary: La Montagne noire is a lyric drama in four acts and five scene by Augusta Holmès from 1884 and created in 1895.

works.title: La morte d'Orfeo
works.summary: La morte d'Orfeo (The Death of Orpheus) is an opera in five acts by the Italian composer Stefano Landi. Dedicated to Alessandro Mattei, familiaris of Pope Paul V, it may have been first performed in Rome in 1619.

works.title: La naissance d'Osiris
works.summary: La naissance d'Osiris, ou La fête Pamilie (The Birth of Osiris, or The Festival of Pamylia) is a one-act opera by Jean-Philippe Rameau, first performed on 12 October 1754 at Fontainebleau to celebrate the birth of King Louis XV's grandson, the future Louis…

works.title: La nave
works.summary: La nave (The Ship) is an opera in a prologue and three "episodes" by Italian composer Italo Montemezzi. Its Italian-language libretto was adapted by Tito Ricordi from Gabriele D'Annunzio's 1908 play of the same name.

works.title: La rose de Saint-Flour
works.summary: La rose de Saint-Flour is a one-act opérette with music by Jacques Offenbach to a French libretto by Michel Carré, first performed in 1856.

works.title: La Salustia
works.summary: La Salustia is a 1732 opera (dramma per musica) in three acts by Giovanni Battista Pergolesi to a revised text, possibly by Sebastiano Morelli, after Apostolo Zeno's famous 1716 libretto Alessandro Severo, which was also later adapted by Handel.

works.title: La tabernera del puerto
works.summary: La tabernera del puerto (also known as Romance Marinero) is a zarzuela in three acts by composer Pablo Sorozábal.

works.title: La vedova scaltra
works.summary: La vedova scaltra is an updated opera-buffa in three acts by Ermanno Wolf-Ferrari to a text by Mario Ghisalberti, after Carlo Goldoni's original play (also called La vedova scaltra) first given in 1748.

works.title: La vera costanza
works.summary: La vera costanza ("True Constancy"), is an operatic dramma giocoso in three acts by Pasquale Anfossi. The comédie larmoyante-influenced Italian libretto was by Francesco Puttini.

works.title: Lady in the Dark
works.summary: Lady in the Dark is a musical with music by Kurt Weill, lyrics by Ira Gershwin and book and direction by Moss Hart.

works.title: Le cheval de bronze
works.summary: Le Cheval de bronze (The Bronze Horse) is an opéra comique by the French composer Daniel Auber, first performed on 23 March 1835 by the Opéra-Comique at the Salle de la Bourse in Paris.

works.title: Le dilettante d'Avignon
works.summary: Le dilettante d'Avignon is an 1829 opéra comique in one act by Fromental Halévy, to a libretto by his brother Léon Halévy, based on an uncompleted work by François-Benoit Hoffmann.

works.title: Le flibustier
works.summary: Le flibustier is a comédie lyrique (lyric comedy) in three acts, composed by César Cui during 1888–1889. Although the title can translate as The Pirate or The Buccaneer, this is no swashbuckling action-drama, but an idyllic domestic comedy of mistaken…

works.title: Le Huron
based_on: The Huron; or, Pupil of Nature
works.summary: Le Huron (The Huron) is a French opéra comique in two acts by André Grétry. The libretto is by Jean-François Marmontel based on the story L'Ingénu (1767) by Voltaire.

works.title: Le jugement de Midas
works.summary: Le Jugement de Midas (The Judgement of Midas) is a French comédie mêlée d'ariettes (a kind of opéra comique), in three acts by André Grétry dedicated to Madame de Montesson.
works.tagline: French comédie mêlée d'ariettes (a kind of opéra comique)

works.title: Le Juif errant
based_on: Le Juif errant by Eugène Sue
works.summary: Le Juif errant (The Wandering Jew) is a grand opera by Fromental Halévy, with a libretto by Eugène Scribe and Jules-Henri Vernoy de Saint-Georges.

works.title: Le lac des fées
works.summary: Le lac des fées (The Fairy Lake) is a grand opera in five acts composed by Daniel Auber to a French libretto by Eugène Scribe and Mélesville (the pen name of Anne-Honoré-Joseph Duveyrier).

works.title: Le maçon
works.summary: Le maçon (French for The Mason) is an opéra comique in three acts by Daniel Auber to a libretto by Eugène Scribe and Germain Delavigne.

works.title: Le Magnifique
works.summary: Le magnifique (The Magnifico) is a French-language opéra comique in three acts by André Grétry to a libretto by Michel-Jean Sedaine, after Jean de La Fontaine; it was first performed on 4 March 1773 at Comédie-Italienne, Paris.

works.title: Le pauvre matelot
works.summary: Le Pauvre Matelot (The Poor Sailor) is a three-act opera (described as a 'complainte') composed by Darius Milhaud with libretto by Jean Cocteau.

works.title: Le pescatrici
works.summary: Le pescatrici (The Fisherwomen) Hob. 28/4, is an opera (dramma giocoso) in three acts by Joseph Haydn set to a libretto by Carlo Goldoni.

works.title: Le philtre
works.summary: Le philtre is an 1831 opera in two acts by Daniel Auber to a libretto by Eugène Scribe set in the Basque country.
works.tagline: 1831 opera in two acts by Daniel Auber

works.title: Le tableau parlant
works.summary: Le tableau parlant is an opéra comique, described as a comédie-parade, in one act by André Grétry. The French libretto was by Louis Anseaume.
works.tagline: Opéra comique in one act by André Grétry

works.title: Leblebici Horhor Ağa
works.summary: Leblebici hor-hor agha (The Chickpea Seller) or Karine is an 1875 operetta by the Ottoman-Armenian composer Tigran Chukhajian.

works.title: Legenda Bałtyku
works.summary: Legenda Bałtyku ("The Legend of the Baltic") is a 1924 Polish opera by Feliks Nowowiejski. It is a neo-romantic nationalist opera.

works.title: Leonora
based_on: Jean-Nicolas Bouilly's Léonore, ou L'amour conjugal
works.summary: Leonora, ossia L’amore coniugale (Leonora or Conjugal Love) is an opera (specifically a dramma semiserio) in two acts by the Italian composer Ferdinando Paer.

works.title: Les aventures du roi Pausole
works.summary: Les aventures du roi Pausole (The adventures of King Pausole) is an opérette in three acts with music by Arthur Honegger and a French libretto by Albert Willemetz, based on the 1901 novel by Pierre Louÿs.

works.title: Les Caprices de Marianne
works.summary: Les caprices de Marianne is a two-act opéra comique by Henri Sauguet with a French libretto by Jean-Pierre Gredy after the 1833 play The Moods of Marianne by Alfred de Musset.

works.title: Les Chevaliers de la Table ronde
works.summary: Les Chevaliers de la table ronde is an operetta by Hervé to a libretto by Henri Chivot and Alfred Duru. The work had its first performance in 1866 at the Théâtre des Bouffes-Parisiens.

works.title: Les deux avares
librettists: Charles-Georges Fenouillot de Falbaire de Quingey
works.summary: Les deux avares is an opéra bouffon in two acts written by André Grétry at age 27 in 1770 to a French libretto by Fenouillot de Falbaire and German version by Herbert Trantow.

works.title: Les Dix Commandements
works.summary: Les Dix Commandements is a French-language musical comedy written by Élie Chouraqui and Pascal Obispo that premiered in Paris in October 2000.

works.title: Les Larmes du couteau
works.summary: Larmes de couteau, H. 169, Knife tears, Czech Slzy nože, is a one-act opera by Bohuslav Martinů to a French libretto by Georges Ribemont-Dessaignes.

works.title: Les mariages samnites
works.summary: Les Mariages samnites (The Samnite Marriages) is an opéra comique, described as a drame lyrique, in three acts by André Grétry, The French text was by Barnabé Farmian Durosoy based on a work by Jean François Marmontel.
works.tagline: Opéra comique in three acts by André Grétry

works.title: Les noces d'Olivette
works.summary: Les noces d'Olivette is an opéra comique in three acts composed by Edmond Audran, with a libretto by Alfred Duru and Henri Charles Chivot.

works.title: Les noces de Jeannette
works.summary: Les noces de Jeannette is an opéra comique in one act by Victor Massé to a libretto by Jules Barbier and Michel Carré.

works.title: Les p'tites Michu
works.summary: Les p'tites Michu (The Little Michus) is an opérette in three acts, with music by André Messager and words by Albert Vanloo and Georges Duval.

works.title: Let 'Em Eat Cake
based_on: Sequel to Of Thee I Sing
works.summary: Let 'Em Eat Cake is a 1933 Broadway musical with music by George Gershwin, lyrics by Ira Gershwin, and book by George S.

works.title: Li zite 'ngalera
works.summary: Li zite 'ngalera (The Newlyweds on the Galley) is a commedia per musica in three acts by the Italian composer Leonardo Vinci, first performed at the Teatro dei Fiorentini, Naples, on 3 January 1722.

works.title: Little Floramye
works.summary: Little Floramye is an operetta in three acts by Croatian composer Ivo Tijardović. It premiered on 14 January 1926 in Split.
works.tagline: 1926 operetta in three acts by Ivo Tijardović

works.title: Little Red Riding Hood
works.summary: Little Red Riding Hood is a fairy-tale opera for children in two acts (three tableaux) by César Cui, composed in 1911.
works.tagline: Opera-fairytale for children in two acts by César Cui

works.title: Lost in the Stars
works.summary: Lost in the Stars is a 1949-premiered musical with book and lyrics by Maxwell Anderson and music by Kurt Weill, based on the novel Cry, the Beloved Country (1948) by Alan Paton.

works.title: Madame l'archiduc
works.summary: Madame l’archiduc is an opéra bouffe, or operetta in three acts, by Jacques Offenbach, with a French libretto by Albert Millaud first performed at the Bouffes-Parisiens (Salle Choiseul) in Paris on 31 October 1874.

works.title: Maître Péronilla
works.summary: Maître Péronilla is an opéra bouffe in three acts of 1878 with music by Jacques Offenbach. The French libretto was by the composer with Charles-Louis-Étienne Nuitter and Paul Ferrier.

works.title: Mala Pasqua!
works.summary: Mala Pasqua! (Bad Easter!) is an opera in three acts composed by Stanislao Gastaldon to a libretto by Giovanni Domenico Bartocci-Fontana.

works.title: Männerlist grösser als Frauenlist
works.summary: Männerlist größer als Frauenlist oder Die glückliche Bärenfamilie is an unfinished Singspiel by Richard Wagner, written between 1837 and 1838.

works.title: Maria Golovin
works.summary: Maria Golovin is an English language opera in three acts by Gian Carlo Menotti. It is through-composed and centers on a romantic encounter between a blind recluse named Donato and the title character, a married woman living in a European country a few years…

works.title: Martin Guerre
works.summary: Martin Guerre is a two-act musical with a book by Claude-Michel Schönberg and Alain Boublil, lyrics by Alain Boublil, Edward Hardy and Stephen Clark, and music by Claude-Michel Schönberg.

works.title: Maybe Happy Ending
works.summary: Maybe Happy Ending is a South Korean musical with lyrics written by Hue Park, music composed by Will Aronson, and book written by both Park and Aronson.

works.title: Medea
works.summary: Medea is an opera in three acts composed by Giovanni Pacini to a libretto by Benedetto Castiglia. It premiered on 28 November 1843 at the Teatro Carolino in Palermo, conducted by the composer with Geltrude Bortolotti in the title role.

works.title: Memphis
works.summary: Memphis is a musical with music by David Bryan, lyrics by Bryan and Joe DiPietro, and a book by DiPietro. The show is loosely based on the story of Memphis disc jockey Dewey Phillips, one of the first white DJs to play black music in the 1950s.

works.title: MJ: The Musical
works.premiere_venue: Neil Simon Theatre, New York City
based_on: The life and music of Michael Jackson
works.summary: MJ the Musical is a jukebox musical based on the life of the American entertainer Michael Jackson, focusing on his preparations for the 1992 Dangerous World Tour.

works.title: Moby-Dick

works.title: Œdipe à Colone

works.title: Oedipus der Tyrann
