works.summary: Oedipus der Tyrann (Oedipus the Tyrant ) is Carl Orff's musical setting of the drama Oedipus Tyrannos in a prologue and five acts by Sophocles in the German translation by Friedrich Hölderlin (1804).

works.title: Paria

works.title: Passion
works.summary: Passion is a one-act musical, with music and lyrics by Stephen Sondheim and a book by James Lapine. The story is adapted from Ettore Scola's 1981 film Passione d'Amore, and its source material, Iginio Ugo Tarchetti's 1869 novel Fosca.

works.title: Peter Ibbetson

works.title: Phantom of the Opera

works.title: Prometeo

works.summary: Prometeo (Prometheus) is an "opera" by Luigi Nono, written between 1981 and 1984 and revised in 1985. Here the word "opera" carries the generic Italian meaning of "works", as in work of art, and not its usual meaning in English.

works.summary: Autumn Sonata (Höstsonaten) is an opera in two acts by composer Sebastian Fagerlund, with a Swedish libretto by Gunilla Hemming based on the screenplay for the 1978 film of the same name by Ingmar Bergman.

works.title: Hugh the Drover

works.title: Hulda
works.summary: Hulda is an opera by César Franck to a French libretto by Charles Grandmougin. It is set in 11th-century Norway, and is based on the play Lame Hulda (1858) by Norwegian writer Bjørnstjerne Bjørnson.

works.title: I Can Get It for You Wholesale
works.summary: I Can Get It for You Wholesale is a musical originally produced by David Merrick, with music and lyrics by Harold Rome, and book by Jerome Weidman, based on his 1937 novel of the same title.

works.title: I due Figaro
works.summary: I due Figaro, o sia Il soggetto di una commedia is an opera (melodramma buffo) in two acts by Saverio Mercadante to a libretto by Felice Romani based on Les deux Figaro by Honoré-Antoine Richaud Martelly.

works.title: I due Figaro

works.title: I Shardana
works.summary: I Shardana is a 1949 opera by Sardinian composer Ennio Porrino, which was premiered in 1959 at the Teatro San Carlo, Naples under Gastone Limarilli and Piero Guelfi.

works.title: Ifigenia in Tauride
works.summary: Ifigenia in Tauride is an opera (opera seria) in three acts by Niccolò Jommelli set to a libretto by the Mannheim court poet Mattia Verazi.

works.title: Ifigenia in Tauride
works.summary: Ifigenia in Tauride is an opera in three acts by Tommaso Traetta to a libretto by Marco Coltellini. It premiered on 4 October 1763 at Schönbrunn Palace, Vienna.

works.title: Il grillo del focolare
works.summary: Il grillo del focolare is an opera in three acts by Riccardo Zandonai to an Italian libretto by Cesare Hanau based on The Cricket on the Hearth by Charles Dickens.

works.title: Il mondo della luna
works.summary: Il mondo della luna (The World of the Moon) is an opera (dramma giocoso) in 3 acts by Baldassare Galuppi. The Italian-language libretto was by Carlo Goldoni.

works.title: Il palazzo incantato
works.summary: Il Palazzo incantato (The Enchanted Palace) or Il Palagio d’Atlante, overo La Guerriera Amante (The Palace of Atlantes, or The Warrior Woman in Love), or also Lealtà con valore (Loyalty with Bravery) is an opera in a prologue and three acts by the Italian…

works.title: Il Parnaso confuso
works.summary: Il Parnaso confuso (Parnassus in Turmoil) is an opera by the composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. It takes the form of an azione teatrale in one act.

works.title: Il Tigrane
works.summary: La Virtù trionfante dell'amore e dell'odio overo Il Tigrane (RV 740) is a 1724 opera for the carnival season in Rome.
works.tagline: Opera by Antonio Vivaldi, Benedetto Micheli and Nicola Romaldi

works.title: Il trionfo di Clelia
works.summary: Il trionfo di Clelia (The Triumph of Cloelia), Wq. 31, is an opera composed by Christoph Willibald Gluck. It takes the form of a dramma per musica in three acts.

works.title: Il trionfo di Clelia
works.summary: Il trionfo di Clelia ("The Triumph of Clelia") is an 18th-century Italian opera in three acts by the Czech composer Josef Mysliveček composed to a libretto by the Italian poet Metastasio for a production mounted in Turin during the carnival operatic season of…

works.title: Ipermestra
works.summary: Ipermestra is an opera by Johann Adolph Hasse. It was the first setting of the libretto by Metastasio, itself following in an already long tradition of operas based on Aeschylus' Suppliants.

works.title: Ipermestra
works.summary: Ipermestra (Hypermnestra) is an opera by the composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. It takes the form of an opera seria in three acts.

works.title: Irrelohe
works.summary: Irrelohe is an opera in three acts by the Austrian composer Franz Schreker, libretto by the composer.

works.title: Isoline
works.summary: Isoline is an opera, described as a conte de fées (fairy story) in three acts and ten tableaux, on a text by Catulle Mendès, with music by André Messager.
works.tagline: Opera on a text by Catulle Mendès

works.title: It's a Bird...It's a Plane...It's Superman
works.summary: It's a Bird... It's a Plane...

works.title: Ivan the Fool
works.summary: Ivan the Fool, composed in 1913 by César Cui, is an opera-fairytale made for children in one act and three tableaux.

works.title: Jaakko Ilkka
works.summary: Jaakko Ilkka is a folk opera by Finnish composer Jorma Panula composed in 1977–1978 which deals with the eponymous peasant leader of the 1596–1597 Cudgel War.

works.title: Jackie O
works.summary: Jackie O is a chamber opera in two acts composed by Michael Daugherty to a libretto by Wayne Koestenbaum. The 90-minute work, commissioned by Houston Grand Opera in 1995 and premiered in 1997, is inspired by American musical and popular culture of the late…
works.tagline: 1997 chamber opera in two acts composed by Michael Daugherty

works.title: Jane Eyre
works.summary: Jane Eyre is a musical drama with music and lyrics by composer-lyricist Paul Gordon and a book by John Caird, based on the 1847 novel by Charlotte Brontë.

works.title: Jean de Nivelle
works.summary: Jean de Nivelle is an opera in three acts by Léo Delibes to a French libretto by Edmond Gondinet and Philippe Gille.
works.tagline: French opera named for Jean de Nivelle

works.title: Jean de Paris
works.summary: Jean de Paris is an opéra comique in two acts by French composer François-Adrien Boieldieu and librettist Claude Godard d'Aucourt de Saint-Just.

works.title: Jerome Robbins' Broadway
works.summary: Jerome Robbins' Broadway is an anthology comprising musical numbers from shows that were either directed or choreographed by Jerome Robbins.

works.title: Jolson
works.summary: Jolson is a musical with a book by Francis Essex and Rob Bettinson and a score composed of tunes by some of the all-time greatest songwriters of Tin Pan Alley.

works.title: Juha
works.summary: Juha is a three-act opera by Aarre Merikanto, with a Finnish libretto by Aino Ackté based on the 1911 novel of the same name by Juhani Aho.

works.title: Kepler
works.summary: Kepler is an opera by Philip Glass set to a libretto in German and Latin by Martina Winkel. It premiered on 20 September 2009 at the Landestheater in the Austrian city of Linz with Dennis Russell Davies conducting the Bruckner Orchestra.

works.title: Kimberly Akimbo
works.summary: Kimberly Akimbo is a musical with music by Jeanine Tesori and lyrics and book by David Lindsay-Abaire. It is based on Lindsay-Abaire's 2001 play of the same name.
works.tagline: 2021 musical by Jeanine Tesori and David Lindsay-Abaire

works.title: King Kong
works.summary: King Kong (1959) was a landmark South African jazz-influenced musical, billed at the time as an "all-African jazz opera".

works.title: Koza-Dereza
works.summary: Koza-dereza is a children's opera in one act by the Ukrainian composer Mykola Lysenko written in 1888 and first performed in 1890 in Lysenko's home in Kyiv.
works.tagline: Ukrainian children's opera composed by Mykola Lysenko

works.title: Kuifje – De Zonnetempel
works.summary: Kuifje – De Zonnetempel, subtitled De Musical, is a 2001 Belgian musical in two acts with music by Dirk Brossé, lyrics and scenario by Seth Gaaikema and Frank van Laecke, based on two of The Adventures of Tintin by Hergé: The Seven Crystal Balls (1948) and…

works.title: Kuningas lähtee Ranskaan
works.summary: Kuningas lähtee Ranskaan is an opera in three acts by Aulis Sallinen, based on the novel of the same title by Paavo Haavikko, who also wrote the libretto.
works.tagline: Opera in three acts by Aulis Sallinen

works.title: Kuningas Lear
works.summary: Kuningas Lear (King Lear) is an opera in two acts by Aulis Sallinen, with a libretto by the composer, based on the play by William Shakespeare and premiered in 2000; it was Sallinen's sixth opera.
works.tagline: Opera in two acts by Aulis Sallinen

works.title: Kuratov
works.summary: Kuratov is an opera by the composer Serge Noskov. It was the first ever opera in the Komi language.

works.title: Kurofune
works.summary: Kurofune is a 1940 Japanese-language Western-style opera by Kosaku Yamada, which is regarded as the first Japanese opera.

works.title: L'amant statue
works.summary: L'amant statue is an opera in one act by composer Nicolas Dalayrac with a French libretto by Desfontaines-Lavallée.

works.title: L'amore innocente
works.summary: L'amore innocente (Innocent Love) composed by Antonio Salieri, is an Italian-language opera in two acts. Stylistically, it is a pastoral opera and is very similar to the mid-18th-century Roman Intermezzo.

works.title: L'écume des jours
works.summary: L'écume des jours is an opera in three acts (14 scenes) composed by the Russian composer Edison Denisov in 1981.

works.tagline: Opéra bouffon in two acts by André Grétry

works.title: L'hôtellerie portugaise
works.summary: L'Hôtellerie portugaise is an opéra comique in 1 act by Luigi Cherubini. The opera uses a French language libretto by Étienne Aignan.

works.title: L'incantesimo
works.summary: L'incantesimo is a short opera in one act by Italian composer Italo Montemezzi. Its libretto was written by playwright Sem Benelli who had previously collaborated with the composer on his most famous opera, L'amore dei tre re.

works.title: L'innocenza giustificata
works.summary: L'innocenza giustificata (Innocence Justified) is an opera by the composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. It takes the form of a festa teatrale in one act.

works.title: L'oiseau bleu
works.summary: L'oiseau bleu (The Blue Bird) is an opera in four acts (eight tableaux) by the French composer and conductor Albert Wolff.

works.title: L'Olimpiade
works.summary: L'Olimpiade is an 18th-century Italian opera in 3 acts by the Czech composer Josef Mysliveček. It was composed to a libretto by the Italian poet Metastasio that was first performed in Vienna in 1733 with music by Antonio Caldara.

works.title: L'Ouragan
works.summary: L'Ouragan is a 1901 opera by Alfred Bruneau to a libretto by Émile Zola.

works.title: L'Upupa und der Triumph der Sohnesliebe
works.premiere_venue: Salzburg Festival by Deutsche Oper Berlin and Teatro Real
works.summary: L'Upupa und der Triumph der Sohnesliebe is an opera by Hans Werner Henze with a German libretto by the composer, inspired by Arab and Persian legends.

works.title: La bella dormente nel bosco
based_on: The Beauty Sleeping in the Wood
works.summary: La bella dormente nel bosco (The sleeping beauty in the woods) is an opera in three acts by Ottorino Respighi to a libretto by Gian Bistolfi based on Charles Perrault's fairy tale "Sleeping Beauty".

works.title: La belle Arsène
works.summary: La belle Arsène (1773) is a French opéra comique by Pierre-Alexandre Monsigny to a libretto by Charles-Simon Favart.

works.title: La Belle et la Bête
works.summary: La Belle et la Bête (The Beauty and the Beast) is an opera for ensemble and film, composed in 1994 by Philip Glass based on a libretto in French by the composer according to the script of the film by Jean Cocteau released in 1946.

works.title: La Camargo
works.summary: La Camargo is a 3-act opéra comique with music by Charles Lecocq and words by Eugène Leterrier and Albert Vanloo.
works.tagline: Opéra comique by Charles Lecocq, Eugène Leterrier and Albert Vanloo

works.title: La chartreuse de Parme
works.summary: La Chartreuse de Parme is a four-act opera in eleven tableaux by Henri Sauguet with a French libretto by Armand Lunel after the 1839 novel of the same name by Stendhal.

works.title: La circassienne
based_on: Louvet de Couvrai's Une année de la vie du chevalier de Faublas
works.summary: La circassienne (The Circassian Woman) is an opera (opéra comique) in three acts composed by Daniel Auber to a French-language libretto by Eugène Scribe based on Louvet de Couvrai's 1787 novel Une année de la vie du chevalier de Faublas.

works.title: La clemenza di Tito

works.title: La contadina astuta

works.title: La contadina in corte
works.summary: La contadina in corte is an opera buffa in two acts by Antonio Sacchini, first performed at the Teatro Valle in Rome during the Carnival in 1765.

works.title: La cour de Célimène

works.title: La donna serpente
works.summary: La donna serpente (The Snake Woman) is a 1932 opera by Alfredo Casella to a libretto by Cesare Vico Lodovici based on the fable, La donna serpente, by Carlo Gozzi.

works.title: La Dori
works.summary: La Dori, overo Lo schiavo reggio (Doris, or The Royal Slave) is a tragi-comic opera in a prologue and three acts composed by Antonio Cesti to a libretto by Giovanni Filippo Apolloni.

works.title: La fauvette du temple
works.summary: La fauvette du temple is an opéra comique in three acts of 1885, with music by André Messager and a French libretto by Paul Burani and Eugène Humbert.
works.tagline: Opéra comique in three acts with music by André Messager

works.title: La finta giardiniera
works.summary: La finta giardiniera is a 1774 opera by Pasquale Anfossi to a libretto by Giuseppe Petrosellini, (sometimes ascribed to Ranieri de' Calzabigi), premiered at the Teatro delle Dame, Rome, for Carnival 1774.

works.title: La finta parigina

works.title: La Flora
works.summary: La Flora, o vero Il natal de' fiori (Flora, or The Birth of Flowers) is an opera in a prologue and five acts composed by Marco da Gagliano and Jacopo Peri to a libretto by Andrea Salvadori.

works.title: La llama

works.title: La Nitteti
works.summary: La Nitteti is an 18th-century Italian opera in 3 acts by the Czech composer Josef Mysliveček. It was composed to a libretto by the Italian poet Metastasio that was first performed in 1756, one of the newer (and less popular) of the Metastasian librettos in…

works.title: La púrpura de la rosa

works.summary: La Rosmira fedele, also known in modern revivals as Partenope, is a 1725 opera by Leonardo Vinci. It is largely based on Domenico Sarro's 1707 setting of Silvio Stampiglia's libretto Partenope but with new arias by Vinci.

works.title: La secchia rapita
based_on: La secchia rapita by Alessandro Tassoni (1622)
works.summary: La secchia rapita (The Stolen Bucket or The Rape of the Bucket) is a three-act 18th century dramma eroicomico opera in Italian.

works.title: La tentation
works.summary: La tentation is a ballet-opera, a hybrid work in which both singers and dancers play major roles. It was premiered in 1832 in its original five-act form by the Paris Opéra at the Salle Le Peletier.

works.title: La ville morte
works.summary: La Ville morte is an opera by Nadia Boulanger and Raoul Pugno to the text of Gabriele D'Annunzio's play La città morta.
works.tagline: Opera by Nadia Boulanger and Raoul Pugno

works.title: Las golondrinas
works.summary: Las golondrinas is a zarzuela by José María Usandizaga. The libretto was written by Gregorio Martínez Sierra and María Lejárraga.

works.title: Le 66

works.title: Le congrès des rois
works.summary: Le congrès des rois (The Congress of the Kings) was a 3-act French Revolutionary opera of the genre comédie mêlée d'ariettes with a libretto by De Maillot, a stage name used by Antoine-François Ève early in his career, and music by a collaborative of twelve…

works.title: Le donne letterate
works.summary: Le donne letterate, composed by Antonio Salieri, is an Italian opera in three acts. Stylistically it is an opera buffa and is very similar to the mid-18th century librettos of Carlo Goldoni.

works.title: Le donne vendicate
works.summary: Le donne vendicate (also titled The Revenge of the Women, Il vago disprezzato and Le fat méprisé) is a musical farce that consists of two intermezzi by composer Niccolò Piccinni with an Italian libretto by Carlo Goldoni.

works.summary: Le financier et le savetier (The financier and the cobbler) is a one-act opérette bouffe of 1856 with words by Hector Crémieux and Edmond About, and music by Jacques Offenbach, based on the poem by La Fontaine.

works.title: Le jour et la nuit
works.summary: Le Jour et la Nuit is an opéra-bouffe with a libretto by Albert Vanloo and Eugène Leterrier and music by Charles Lecocq.

works.title: Le maître de chapelle

works.title: Le petit duc
works.summary: Le Petit Duc is an opéra comique in three acts by Charles Lecocq. The French libretto was by Henri Meilhac and Ludovic Halévy.

works.title: Le piccole storie
works.summary: Le piccole storie, subtitled Ai margini delle guerre, is a one-act chamber opera for young people by Lorenzo Ferrero set to an Italian-language libretto by Giuseppe Di Leva.

works.title: Le roi et le fermier

works.title: Le roman d'Elvire

works.title: Le stravaganze del conte

works.title: Le timbre d'argent
works.summary: Le timbre d'argent is an opéra fantastique in four acts by composer Camille Saint-Saëns to a French libretto by Jules Barbier and Michel Carré.

works.title: Le tribut de Zamora
works.summary: Le tribut de Zamora is a grand opera in four acts by Charles Gounod, to a libretto by Adolphe d'Ennery and Jules Brésil set in Moorish Spain shortly after the Battle of Zamora in 939 CE.

works.title: Leave It to Me!

works.title: Les amours de Ragonde
works.summary: Les amours de Ragonde is an opera in three acts by Jean-Joseph Mouret with a libretto by Philippe Néricault Destouches.

works.title: Les fêtes de Ramire
works.summary: Les fêtes de Ramire (The Celebrations of Ramiro) is an opera in the form of a one-act acte de ballet by Jean-Philippe Rameau with a libretto by Voltaire, first performed on 22 December 1745 at the Palace of Versailles.

works.title: Les Horaces
works.summary: Les Horaces (The Horatii) is an operatic tragédie lyrique by Antonio Salieri. The text was by Nicolas-François Guillard after Pierre Corneille's Horace.

works.title: Les martyrs
works.summary: Les martyrs is a four-act grand opera by Gaetano Donizetti set to a French libretto by Eugène Scribe. The libretto was based on one written by Salvadore Cammarano for an original Italian version known as Poliuto, which was not performed until after the…

works.title: Les plaisirs de Versailles

works.title: Les Trois Souhaits

works.title: Lestat

works.tagline: 2005 Broadway musical based on the novels by Anne Rice

works.title: Linie 1

works.title: Little Johnny Jones
works.summary: Little Johnny Jones is a musical by George M. Cohan.

works.title: Lolita
works.summary: Lolita is an opera in two acts by composer Rodion Shchedrin. Composed in 1992, it uses a Russian language libretto by the composer which is based on Vladimir Nabokov's 1955 novel of the same name, written in English.

works.title: Lord Byron

works.title: Los diamantes de la corona

works.title: Love and Malice
works.summary: Love and Malice is an opera in two acts composed by Vatroslav Lisinski to a libretto by Dimitrija Demeter. It premiered on 28 March 1846 in Zagreb and is considered to be the first Croatian national opera, making Croatia the second Slavic nation to have its…

works.title: Luci mie traditrici
works.summary: Luci mie traditrici (My Traitorous Eyes) is an opera in two acts by Salvatore Sciarrino, who also wrote the libretto.

works.title: Lucile

works.title: Lucrezia
works.summary: Lucrezia is an opera in one act and three tableaux by Ottorino Respighi to a libretto by Claudio Guastalla, after Livy and William Shakespeare's The Rape of Lucrece, itself based heavily on Ovid's Fasti.

works.title: Madame Pompadour
works.summary: Madame Pompadour is an operetta in three acts, composed by Leo Fall with a libretto by Rudolph Schanzer and Ernst Welisch.

works.title: Marcella (Giordano)
